mostWorthwhile.text: Feeding glucose to the cell was most worthwhile: the result connected glucose, oxygen and mitochondria to ATP, which later helped power protein building.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mitochondria was less engaging on its own: placing them made sense, but that result did not yet show how ATP was made.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the picture showed ATP being used beside the protein-building machinery without becoming part of the protein.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the final ATP-and-cell pairing followed the only offered option and the goal rather than a detailed understanding of how it works.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because connecting food to cell work and protein building made me curious about how these pieces lead to tissues and organs.
